# @astrolib

Vendored copies of [`@astrolib/seo`](https://github.com/onwidget/astrolib) (1.0.0-beta.8) and `@astrolib/analytics` (0.6.1) by onWidget, MIT licensed.

These packages are no longer maintained and only support Astro 5 and lower, so their sources live here to keep upgrading Astro.

They are still imported as `@astrolib/seo` and `@astrolib/analytics` thanks to an alias (`vite.resolve.alias` in `astro.config.ts` and `paths` in `tsconfig.json`).
